name: Voltaire
summary: Voltaire admired the English balance of king, lords and commons as a guard against arbitrary power, and doubted that most peoples could govern themselves democratically. He campaigned against religious persecution and clerical power, wanting the clergy kept under civil authority and spiritual only, while holding religion useful for the common people. He defended property, commerce and luxury, and accepted social inequality as unavoidable.
